integrity: All proof, claim and testing details are contained in the science package; finite checks are explicitly distinguished from infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Requires finite complete cups, type-defining atomic literals and the original weak three-valued belief semantics. Counts labeled fixed valuations, not unlabeled isomorphism types. Critical windows require fixed number of colors and independent directed cross-color edges. Historical priority and independent validation remain unestablished.
title: Atomic-support saturation and two critical density windows for directed simplicial cups
